race.comment: KENDALIA (3) didn't handle the Heavy going behind a subsequent winner last time out, with his form prior on better going stacking right up. Firmer footing this time is a big tick,as is the drop in trip. Expecting a much better effort this time. CHOLANTE (1) was fair off a very long break first-up and should be better for that performance. She boasts a strong second-up record, running behind the very handy So You Pence when second-up last campaign. Loy now hops on board and she can put her best foot forward. CASHBOOK (2) will appreciate the firmer footing today and can fire with the winkers going on. GEM TYCOON (6) can bounce back to form after failing on the heavy deck last time.
